this_title: Medina: El estafador de famosos Season 1
trans_title: 麦地那：专骗名人的骗子 第一季
introduction: There is a mysterious character in Spain who has spent the last 20 years swindling small amounts of money from many television personalities posing as someone who had worked with them with a personal drama. One of these conned people is Jorge Ponce, who sets out to find the swindler using all the resources at his disposal: from private detectives to the large catalog of comedians who are victims of the scam.
